title: Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.08086v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can revise earlier predictions as context evolves, but rollback requires costly full-sequence recomputation. Conventional key-value (KV) caching assumes immutable historical states and is difficult to reconcile with such revision. We introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer recomputes the mutable response at every update while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded response-state neighborhood. This asymmetric boundary amortizes prompt computation without restricting rollback. Bounded reuse also delays feedback from tentative tokens while keeping response revision active. Our analysis characterizes the cache boundary, bounds state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions. translated_title: Archer：面向扩散语言模型高效回滚的缓存隐藏状态自适应复用
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）能够随着上下文的演化修订较早的预测，但回滚操作需要对整个序列进行代价高昂的重计算。传统的键值缓存方法假设历史状态不可变，难以与这种修订机制相兼容。我们提出了Archer，一种面向支持回滚的扩散语言模型的免训练缓存方法。Archer在每次更新时重新计算可变的响应部分，同时在有界的响应状态邻域内复用提示词的K/V状态。这种非对称边界在摊销提示词计算开销的同时不会限制回滚能力。有界复用还延迟了来自临时token的反馈，同时保持响应修订机制的活跃性。我们的分析刻画了缓存边界，给出了依赖状态的近似误差上界，并提出了保持全刷新决策的解码器边际条件。在代码生成基准测试中，Archer取得了最佳的平均性能表现。
tldr: Archer是一种免训练的缓存方法，通过在每次更新时仅重计算可变的响应部分并复用提示词的键值缓存，使扩散语言模型在不牺牲回滚能力的前提下大幅降低全序列重计算的开销。
en_tdlr: Archer is a training-free caching method that recomputes only the mutable response at each update while adaptively reusing prompt key-value states, enabling efficient rollback in diffusion language models without the costly full-sequence recomputation.
